description:
Elevate Your Event With Custom Backdrop Printing

Transform any event into a memorable occasion with our custom backdrops. Ideal for a variety of settings, from weddings and parties to festivals and corporate events, our backdrops add a touch of personalization and professionalism. Use high-resolution images or your company logo to create a step-and-repeat banner that stands out, or opt for custom photo backdrops to enhance the ambiance of company gatherings and other significant occasions.

Customization Options

Personalize your backdrop with any design, from logos to high-quality images. Ideal for photography, weddings, stages, and more, these backdrops add a professional touch to your event.

Standard Sizes for Every Occasion

5' x 8'



Perfect for intimate photos at weddings and parties.


8' x 8'



Accommodates three people comfortably; suitable for company events.

10' x 8'



Spacious enough for a group of five adults, recommended for festivals or events with large gatherings.

How to Assemble Your Backdrops

Assembling your custom backdrop is straightforward, ensuring you're prepared for your event with minimal hassle. Here's how to set it up:

1

Position

the poles in the designated display area.

2

Secure

the metal bases to the vertical poles for stability.

3

Slide

the horizontal poles into the banner's pole pockets.

4

Connect

the horizontal poles to the vertical ones and elevate the backdrop into place.

Our backdrops are designed for easy transport and assembly, so you can quickly set up a professional display in any location. Choose between durable, glare-free 13 oz. or larger 18 oz. vinyl material for a long-lasting backdrop. For added convenience, backdrops may include pole pockets or grommets, which eliminate the need for a stand. However, if a stand is preferred, our photo backdrop stand comes with a carrying bag for effortless transportation.


Whether you're an events company looking to enhance your service offerings with wedding backdrops or seeking to maximize sponsor exposure with red carpet backdrops, our custom printing solutions cater to your needs. Create an unforgettable backdrop for any event, large or small, with our customizable options and easy-to-assemble design.


Design Tips for Backdrops

Font Selection: Clarity from Afar

When incorporating text into your backdrop design, choose fonts that are easy to read at a distance. Sans serif fonts, known for their clean lines and bold presence, are ideal for ensuring your message stands out.

Opt for a Matte Finish

Our backdrops are printed on high-quality vinyl with a matte finish, reducing glare and enhancing readability. This finish ensures that both colors and images appear vibrant and clear, making your backdrop stand out in any setting.

Color and Image Choices

Select colors and images that complement each other and maintain their vibrancy when printed. Consider the overall theme and how your choices will interact with your design to create a cohesive and striking visual impact.

Organizing Your Design

Layout is key to a visually appealing backdrop. Arrange your elements—whether they are images, text, or graphics—in a manner that each has its own space and contributes to the overall message without competing for attention. This clean and organized approach ensures your backdrop is effective and engaging.

Custom Backdrops FAQs

Our custom backdrops are designed with durability in mind, making them suitable for both indoor and outdoor events. However, for outdoor use, we recommend using a ballast for the stands such as sandbags.

Yes, you have the option to print on both sides of your backdrops.

Your backdrop will print exactly as shown in your approved artwork proof. If you would like a step-and-repeat pattern with repeating logos, the artwork must be designed that way before printing. Otherwise, a single uploaded logo or image will typically print as one large graphic on the backdrop.

Yes, you can print an image onto your backdrop. Before turning over the file, make sure that it is in 300 dpi resolution. Otherwise, it will appear stretched and pixelated upon printing.

To print your own design on a backdrop, simply upload your high-resolution image or design file through our website.

Yes, our website features a user-friendly online design tool that allows you to create your custom backdrop directly. Choose from a variety of templates, upload images, and customize your design to suit your event or promotional needs.

Yes, we offer a proofing service before proceeding with the full print run. This ensures that your design looks exactly as you envisioned it and meets your standards for quality and impact.

Custom backdrops may be sold as the printed graphic only or as a complete set with a stand/frame, depending on the product option selected. Please review the product description carefully to confirm what is included with your order, as stands and hardware may need to be purchased separately.

Unfortunately, we do not sell the stands separately. Our offerings include either the complete set of backdrop with stand or the backdrop alone.
